pick.headline: Employers Proud to Offer Workers Same Health Coverage at Exciting New Price
pick.take: Premiums rose again, especially for small businesses, which now get to experience the full insurance market the way a patient experiences a surprise bill. Nobody is sure what the extra money bought, but the deductible remains in excellent health.
